concerns.text: Plan element 'T-Gen-Adaptive' (adaptive sampling densifying depth steps near the 1% error threshold in generator.py) has no matching task in tasks.md — neither in the remaining tasks nor in the 'Completed work (verified)' list. Either a task must cover it or its omission must be explicitly recorded; currently it is silently dropped.

The plan lists 'contracts/tradeoff_curve.schema.yaml' as a Phase 1 deliverable, but the completed-contracts list names only workflow, execution_log, and analysis_results schemas. No task (open or completed) delivers the tradeoff-curve schema, which should govern T070's output columns — a missing plan element.

T070 produces 'data/results/threshold_ci.json' with keys ci_lower/ci_upper, but the plan specifies 'data/results/threshold_report.json' as the threshold artifact. The task's deliverable does not match the plan element's named artifact; T070 should either produce the plan-named file or the discrepancy must be reconciled so the verifier can find the expected artifact.

All tasks and commands reference 'code/main.py', 'code/utils/...', while the plan's Project Structure places all source under 'src/' (models/, services/, cli/, lib/). No task reconciles or migrates the layout, so the plan's structure elements (src/models/policy.py, src/services/executor.py, etc.) have no matching task coverage and the constitution-mandated 'code/' location conflicts with the plan.
